title: Pytania i odpowiedzi KSeF 2.0 - KSeF (Krajowy System e-Faktur)
content:
Source: KSeF podatki.gov.pl - FAQ i zasady obowiązywania
URL: https://ksef.podatki.gov.pl/pytania-i-odpowiedzi-ksef-20/?category=&query=nabywc%C4%99
- The page “Pytania i odpowiedzi KSeF 2.0 – KSeF” provides a centralized, continually updated FAQ for KSeF (Krajowy System e-Faktur).
- It covers basic information about KSeF, including its purpose (a system for creating, sending, receiving, and storing structured invoices) and its rollout in Poland, with a staged implementation starting February 1, 2026.
- Content is developed in collaboration with businesses, integrators, and participants of webinars and consultations, and is organized into categories to help users find answers quickly.
- Users are encouraged to submit questions to expand the knowledge base.
- The page includes a search tool and category navigation to browse topics, specifically under “Podstawowe informacje o KSeF” and other sections.
